content_html:
A live, glanceable status display for your macOS Dock.

DockMagic is a native macOS app that turns its own Dock icon into a small, live status display. It keeps one feature active at a time so the Dock remains glanceable and background work stays bounded.

DockMagic does not add a menu bar item. Click the Dock icon or press Command-, to open its single Settings window.

Screenshots

Select one active Dock feature and choose the app appearance.

Screenshots show Dark appearance. Live values vary by Mac and capture time. Click any screenshot to view it at full resolution.

Features

  • DockMagic displays the DockMagic logo without running a metrics provider.
  • CPU & RAM displays system-wide CPU usage in the outer ring and used RAM in the inner ring. Both values are sampled locally at 1 Hz.
  • Network charts traffic for the primary network interface, with upload above and download below the baseline. Both directions share a linear scale that expands with traffic. The Dock keeps the latest 30 samples, while the sampler keeps up to 60 in-memory samples at 1 Hz.
  • Storage displays used capacity on the startup volume and refreshes locally every five seconds.
  • Weather renders the current temperature and condition for Dock sizes from 32...128 pt; larger tiles also show the daily high and low. It uses the current macOS location, refreshes from Open-Meteo every ten minutes while active, reverse-geocodes the place name for the Dock preview, and retains the most recent successful result if a refresh fails.
  • Codex displays the remaining five-hour and weekly usage windows. When selected, DockMagic locates the installed Codex CLI and calls codex app-server --stdio with the existing login. If the account does not return a five-hour window, DockMagic displays only the weekly value instead of inventing missing data.
  • Claude Code displays the same five-hour and weekly windows. DockMagic uses Claude Code's official statusLine contract and caches only the rate_limits object after a response. Selecting the feature installs the default local bridge automatically, preserves any previous status-line command, and does not call internal OAuth endpoints.
  • General settings select exactly one feature to run and display in the Dock. CPU & RAM, Storage, Codex, and Claude Code support Chart and Numbers display styles. Colors and display choices are persisted and applied to the active tile immediately.
  • Appearance supports System, Light, and Dark. Navigation chrome uses Liquid Glass where available and a material fallback on the current toolchain, while primary content remains opaque.

The default color for both Claude Code rings is the coral #D97757 sampled from the provided Claude Code logo. Users can still customize each ring separately.

Privacy and distribution

DockMagic is designed for direct distribution, not the Mac App Store.

  • CPU & RAM, Network, and Storage data is processed only on the Mac. Network history remains in memory and is not persisted.
  • Weather sends the current coordinates to Open-Meteo over HTTPS and stores only the last successful snapshot for failure recovery. It does not keep location history. macOS requests Location permission through the standard system prompt.
  • The Codex integration does not read or store tokens, prompts, or account identifiers. It reads only the rate-limit response returned by the installed Codex CLI.
  • The Claude Code cache at ~/.claude/dockmagic-usage.json contains only rate_limits. DockMagic does not read transcripts, OAuth tokens, API keys, or Keychain data.

The app does not require Accessibility, Screen Recording, Full Disk Access, or administrator privileges. Weather alone requires Location Services and network access.

Production releases must use Developer ID signing, Hardened Runtime, notarization, stapling, and a Gatekeeper smoke test on a clean Mac. Contributions must not introduce Mac App Store-only packaging or capabilities unless the direct-distribution impact has been evaluated and documented.

Requirements

  • macOS 14.0 or later
  • Xcode 15.4 or later
  • Swift 5
  • Location Services and a network connection only when using Weather; see the Open-Meteo integration contract
  • An installed Codex CLI only when using Codex
  • An installed Claude Code CLI only when using Claude Code; rate_limits requires a supported subscription and at least one response after automatic bridge setup

DockMagic is an Xcode project, not a Swift Package. It currently has no external package dependencies.

Getting started

  1. Fork the repository on GitHub, then clone your fork:

    git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/dockmagic.git
cd dockmagic
git remote add upstream https://github.com/thanhdongnguyen/dockmagic.git

  2. Open DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj in Xcode.

  3. Select the DockMagic scheme and the My Mac destination.

  4. Build with Command-B, or use the unsigned command below for a build-only verification.

The Xcode project contains the maintainer's development-team setting. If Xcode asks for a signing identity, select your own team locally. Do not include personal signing changes in a pull request.

Build and test

Build and launch

The helper script builds into .derivedData, stops an existing DockMagic process, and launches the Debug app using the project's current signing setup:

./script/build_and_run.sh
./script/build_and_run.sh --verify

Other supported modes are --debug, --logs, and --telemetry:

./script/build_and_run.sh --logs

For an unsigned build-only check, run:

xcodebuild \
  -project DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj \
  -scheme DockMagic \
  -configuration Debug \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath /tmp/DockMagicDerivedData \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  build

Unit tests

Unit tests can use an unsigned build:

xcodebuild \
  -project DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj \
  -scheme DockMagic \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath /tmp/DockMagicUnitTests \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  -only-testing:DockMagicTests \
  test

UI tests

macOS UI tests require a valid Apple Development signing identity. Do not add CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO; AppleSystemPolicy will otherwise block the XCUI runner.

xcodebuild \
  -project DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj \
  -scheme DockMagic \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath /tmp/DockMagicUITests \
  -only-testing:DockMagicUITests \
  test

Use a separate Derived Data directory for each build or test lane. Concurrent commands that share one directory can contend for build.db and produce misleading failures.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Small fixes can go directly to a pull request. Open an issue before investing in a large feature, a new external service, a new entitlement, a persistence change, or a release/distribution change. Early discussion helps confirm that the proposal fits DockMagic's focused Dock-tile model and privacy boundary.

Development workflow

  1. Check existing issues and pull requests to avoid duplicate work.

  2. Create a focused branch from the repository's default branch:

    git fetch upstream
git switch -c feature/short-description upstream/main

  3. Make one coherent change. Avoid unrelated formatting or generated-file churn.

  4. Add or update tests for behavior changes. Update documentation when a user flow, privacy boundary, dependency, permission, or architecture contract changes.

  5. Run the relevant build and test commands from this README. Also run:

    git diff --check

  6. Push the branch to your fork and open a pull request against main.

Engineering guidelines

  • Preserve the single active feature contract. Inactive providers and samplers must stop rather than continue polling in the background.
  • Keep the long-lived DockTileController ownership model. Update its existing presentation and explicitly redraw the NSDockTile; do not create a new controller for every sample.
  • Keep UI-facing mutable state on @MainActor. Prefer immutable, Sendable snapshots at concurrency boundaries and dependency injection for testable providers.
  • Use public macOS APIs that support Developer ID distribution. Explain any new entitlement, permission, network request, on-disk data, or third-party service in both tests and documentation.
  • Keep monitoring local by default and collect only the minimum data required. Never commit credentials, tokens, personal paths, transcripts, or private sample payloads.
  • Use semantic colors and shared components from DesignSystem instead of introducing one-off visual constants. Verify UI changes in System, Light, and Dark appearances, at small Dock sizes, and with relevant accessibility settings.
  • Preserve existing accessibility labels and identifiers. Add them for new interactive controls and non-text status states.
  • Follow the existing Swift style: four-space indentation, descriptive names, small focused types, and no unrelated refactors in a feature pull request.
  • Do not commit .derivedData, local Xcode user data, build products, logs, or signing-only project changes.

Pull request checklist

A pull request should include:

  • A concise explanation of the problem and the chosen solution.
  • The user-visible behavior and any privacy, performance, permission, or distribution impact.
  • Tests added or updated, plus the exact commands run and their results.
  • Screenshots or a short recording for visible Settings or Dock changes. Include the tested appearance, Dock size, and macOS version.
  • Documentation updates for changed contracts or contributor workflows.
  • A focused diff with no secrets, personal signing settings, or unrelated generated changes.

Not every change needs every test suite. State clearly what was and was not verified so reviewers can distinguish source review, unit tests, builds, UI tests, and manual Dock inspection.

Community expectations

Be respectful, constructive, and specific. Discuss the work rather than the person, assume good intent, and make space for contributors with different levels of experience. Harassment, discrimination, and disclosure of another person's private information are not acceptable. A standalone CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md has not yet been published; maintainers should add one before growing the contributor community.

Reporting bugs and security issues

Use GitHub Issues for reproducible bugs and feature requests. A useful bug report includes:

  • macOS and Xcode versions;
  • Dock position, size, magnification, and appearance when visually relevant;
  • the active DockMagic feature and display style;
  • exact reproduction steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior;
  • relevant logs with tokens, usernames, coordinates, and personal paths removed; and
  • screenshots or a minimal sample when appropriate.

Do not publish credentials, tokens, precise location data, or an exploitable security report in a public issue. This repository does not yet provide a SECURITY.md or a documented private reporting address. Until one is added, contact the repository owner privately through an available GitHub contact method and disclose only the minimum detail needed to establish a secure channel.

License

This repository does not currently include a software license. Until the maintainers add one, standard copyright restrictions apply: source availability alone does not grant permission to use, modify, or redistribute the code. An OSI-approved license should be selected and added before DockMagic is described or distributed as open-source software.

content_html_zh:
macOS Dock 的实时、一目了然的状态显示。

DockMagic 是一款原生 macOS 应用程序，它将自己的 Dock 图标变成一个小型的实时状态显示。 它一次保持一项功能处于活动状态，因此 Dock 保持一目了然，并且后台工作保持有限。

DockMagic 不添加菜单栏项目。 单击 Dock 图标或按 Command- 打开其单个设置窗口。

内容

  • 截图
  • 特征
  • 隐私和分发
  • 要求
  • 入门
  • 构建和测试
  • 项目结构
  • 贡献
  • 报告错误和安全问题
  • 执照

截图

选择一项活动的 Dock 功能并选择应用程序外观。

屏幕截图显示深色外观。 实时值因 Mac 和捕获时间而异。 单击任意屏幕截图即可以全分辨率查看。

特征

  • DockMagic 显示 DockMagic 徽标，而不运行指标提供程序。
  • CPU & RAM 外环显示系统范围内的 CPU 使用情况，内环显示已用 RAM。 这两个值均以 1 Hz 的频率进行本地采样。
  • 网络绘制主要网络接口的流量图，上传高于基线，下载低于基线。 两个方向共享一个随着交通量而扩展的线性尺度。 Dock 保留最新的 30 个样本，而采样器以 1 Hz 的频率保存最多 60 个内存样本。
  • 存储显示启动卷上的已用容量，并每五秒在本地刷新一次。
  • 天气渲染码头尺寸从 32...128 pt 的当前温度和状况；较大的瓷砖还显示每日的高点和低点。 它使用当前的 macOS 位置，在活动期间每十分钟从 Open-Meteo 刷新一次，对 Dock 预览的地点名称进行反向地理编码，并在刷新失败时保留最近的成功结果。
  • Codex 显示剩余的五小时和每周使用窗口。 选择后，DockMagic 会找到已安装的 Codex CLI 并使用现有登录名调用 codex app-server --stdio。 如果帐户未返回五小时窗口，DockMagic 将仅显示每周值，而不是创建丢失的数据。
  • Claude Code 显示相同的五小时窗口和每周窗口。 DockMagic 使用 Claude Code 的官方 statusLine 合约，并在响应后仅缓存rate_limits 对象。 选择该功能会自动安装默认本地桥，保留任何以前的状态行命令，并且不会调用内部 OAuth 端点。
  • 常规设置仅选择一项功能来运行并显示在 Dock 中。 CPU & RAM、存储、Codex 和 Claude Code 支持图表和数字显示样式。 颜色和显示选择将保留并立即应用于活动图块。
  • 外观支持系统、浅色和深色。 导航镶边使用液体玻璃（如果可用）和当前工具链上的材料后备，而主要内容仍然不透明。

两个 Claude Code 戒指的默认颜色是从提供的 Claude Code 徽标中采样的珊瑚色 #D97757。 用户仍然可以单独定制每个环。

隐私和分发

DockMagic 专为直接分发而设计，而不是 Mac App Store。

  • CPU 和 RAM、网络和存储数据仅在 Mac 上处理。 网络历史记录保留在内存中并且不会持久化。
  • Weather 通过 HTTPS 将当前坐标发送到 Open-Meteo，并仅存储最后一次成功的快照以供故障恢复。 它不保留位置历史记录。 macOS 通过标准系统提示请求位置权限。
  • Codex 集成不会读取或存储令牌、提示或帐户标识符。 它仅读取已安装的 Codex CLI 返回的速率限制响应。
  • ~/.claude/dockmagic-usage.json 中的 Claude 代码缓存仅包含rate_limits。 DockMagic 不读取脚本、OAuth 令牌、API 密钥或钥匙串数据。

该应用程序不需要辅助功能、屏幕录制、全磁盘访问或管理员权限。 仅天气就需要定位服务和网络访问。

生产版本必须在干净的 Mac 上使用开发人员 ID 签名、强化运行时、公证、装订和 Gatekeeper 冒烟测试。 贡献不得引入仅限 Mac App Store 的打包或功能，除非已经评估和记录了直接分发影响。

要求

  • macOS 14.0 或更高版本
  • Xcode 15.4 或更高版本
  • Swift 5
  • 仅在使用天气时提供定位服务和网络连接；请参阅 Open-Meteo 集成合同
  • 仅当使用 Codex 时才安装 Codex CLI
  • 仅当使用 Claude Code 时才安装 Claude Code CLI； rate_limits 需要受支持的订阅，并且在自动桥接设置后至少有一个响应

DockMagic 是一个 Xcode 项目，而不是 Swift Package。 目前它没有外部包依赖项。

入门

  1. 在 GitHub 上分叉存储库，然后克隆您的分叉： git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/dockmagic.git cd dockmagic git Remote 添加上游 https://github.com/thanhdongnguyen/dockmagic.git
  2. 在 Xcode 中打开 DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj。
  3. 选择 DockMagic 方案和 My Mac 目标。
  4. 使用 Command-B 进行构建，或使用下面的未签名命令进行仅构建验证。

Xcode 项目包含维护者的开发团队设置。 如果 Xcode 要求签名身份，请在本地选择您自己的团队。 不要在拉取请求中包含个人签名更改。

构建和测试

构建并启动

帮助程序脚本构建到 .衍生数据中，停止现有的 DockMagic 进程，并使用项目的当前签名设置启动调试应用程序：

./script/build_and_run.sh
./script/build_and_run.sh --verify

其他支持的模式包括 --debug、--logs 和 --telemetry：

./script/build_and_run.sh --logs

对于未签名的仅构建检查，请运行：

xcodebuild \
  -project DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj \
  -scheme DockMagic \
  -configuration Debug \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath /tmp/DockMagicDerivedData \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  build

单元测试

单元测试可以使用未签名的构建：

xcodebuild \
  -project DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj \
  -scheme DockMagic \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath /tmp/DockMagicUnitTests \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  -only-testing:DockMagicTests \
  test

用户界面测试

macOS UI 测试需要有效的 Apple 开发签名身份。 不要添加 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO；否则 AppleSystemPolicy 将阻止 XCUI 运行程序。

xcodebuild \
  -project DockMagic/DockMagic.xcodeproj \
  -scheme DockMagic \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath /tmp/DockMagicUITests \
  -only-testing:DockMagicUITests \
  test

为每个构建或测试通道使用单独的派生数据目录。 共享一个目录的并发命令可能会争用 build.db 并产生误导性的失败。

更改相应子系统前请阅读以下文档：

  • 建筑学
  • 设计体系

  • 克劳德代码使用集成

贡献

欢迎贡献。 小的修复可以直接进入拉取请求。 在投资大型功能、新的外部服务、新的权利、持久性更改或发布/分发更改之前提出问题。 早期讨论有助于确认该提案符合 DockMagic 的重点 Dock-tile 模型和隐私边界。

开发流程

  1. 检查现有问题并拉取请求以避免重复工作。
  2. 从存储库的默认分支创建一个焦点分支： git fetch uploader git switch -c feature/short-descriptionupstream/main
  3. 做出一项连贯的改变。 避免不相关的格式或生成的文件混乱。
  4. 添加或更新行为变化的测试。 当用户流程、隐私边界、依赖性、权限或架构合同发生变化时更新文档。
  5. 运行本自述文件中的相关构建和测试命令。 同时运行： git diff --check
  6. 将分支推送到您的分支并针对主分支打开拉取请求。

工程指南

  • 保留单个活动功能合约。 不活跃的提供者和采样者必须停止而不是继续在后台进行轮询。
  • 保留长期存在的 DockTileController 所有权模型。 更新其现有的呈现并显式重绘 NSDockTile；不要为每个样本创建一个新的控制器。
  • 在 @MainActor 上保持面向 UI 的可变状态。 更喜欢并发边界处的不可变、可发送快照以及可测试提供程序的依赖注入。
  • 使用支持开发者 ID 分发的公共 macOS API。 在测试和文档中解释任何新的权利、许可、网络请求、磁盘数据或第三方服务。
  • 默认情况下保持本地监控并仅收集所需的最少数据。 切勿提交凭证、令牌、个人路径、记录或私有样本有效负载。
  • 使用 DesignSystem 中的语义颜色和共享组件，而不是引入一次性视觉常量。 验证系统、浅色和深色外观、小 Dock 尺寸以及相关辅助功能设置中的 UI 更改。
  • 保留现有的辅助功能标签和标识符。 添加它们以实现新的交互式控件和非文本状态。
  • 遵循现有的 Swift 风格：四空格缩进、描述性名称、小型集中类型，并且功能拉取请求中没有不相关的重构。
  • 不要提交 .衍生数据、本地 Xcode 用户数据、构建产品、日志或仅签名的项目更改。

拉取请求清单

拉取请求应包括：

  • 对问题和所选解决方案的简明解释。
  • 用户可见的行为以及任何隐私、性能、许可或分发影响。
  • 添加或更新的测试，以及运行的确切命令及其结果。
  • 可见设置或 Dock 更改的屏幕截图或简短记录。 包括测试的外观、Dock 大小和 macOS 版本。
  • 更改合同或贡献者工作流程的文档更新。
  • 没有秘密、个人签名设置或不相关的生成更改的集中差异。

并非每个变更都需要每个测试套件。 清楚地说明哪些内容已验证，哪些内容未验证，以便审阅者可以区分源代码审阅、单元测试、构建、UI 测试和手动 Dock 检查。

社会期望

保持尊重、建设性和具体。 讨论工作而不是人，表现出良好的意图，并为具有不同经验水平的贡献者留出空间。 骚扰、歧视和泄露他人私人信息是不可接受的。 独立的 CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md 尚未发布；维护者应该在发展贡献者社区之前添加一个。

报告错误和安全问题

使用 GitHub Issues 来获取可重现的错误和功能请求。 有用的错误报告包括：

  • macOS 和 Xcode 版本；
  • 视觉相关时的停靠位置、尺寸、放大倍率和外观；
